clips.send: Medical teams abroad (Algeria, 1963). Doctors sent abroad for 60 years. China sent its first medical team to Algeria in 1963. Since then teams have worked in more than 70 countries, mostly in Africa, treating about 290 million patients (figure as of 2023). During COVID-19 China sent medical supplies and vaccines to many countries.

clips.send: Suez Canal. A port on the “Road”. The canal in Egypt that lets ships pass from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean without sailing around Africa.

clips.send: China at the United Nations. A permanent member of the Security Council. In 1971 the UN General Assembly restored the lawful seat of the People’s Republic of China. China is one of five permanent members of the Security Council and the second-largest payer of the UN budget. Textbook: China is a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development and a defender of international order.

clips.send: The Belt and Road. One belt on land, one road at sea. Proposed by China in 2013, it revives the idea of the ancient Silk Road: building railways, ports and trade links together with other countries. More than 150 countries have signed cooperation documents. Click the dots (stops) and gold diamonds (China’s contributions). Use the switches and drag the year.

clips.send: Jakarta–Bandung High-Speed Railway. Southeast Asia’s first high-speed line. 142 km in Indonesia, trains at 350 km/h, opened October 2023. The trip between Jakarta and Bandung fell from over 3 hours to about 40 minutes. Built jointly by Indonesian and Chinese companies using Chinese high-speed rail technology.

clips.send: Mombasa–Nairobi Railway, Kenya. Kenya’s first new railway in a century. About 480 km, built by a Chinese company and opened in 2017. It cut the trip from the port of Mombasa to the capital Nairobi from over 10 hours to about 5. Bridges and underpasses let giraffes and elephants cross the line in Tsavo National Park.

clips.send: UN peacekeepers (South Sudan). The “blue helmets”. China first sent military observers to a UN mission in 1990; since then it has sent more than 50,000 peacekeepers. Among the five permanent members of the UN Security Council, China sends the most peacekeepers; it is the second-largest payer of peacekeeping costs. In South Sudan, Chinese units protect civilians, build roads and run a hospital.

clips.send: China–Europe freight trains. A “steel camel caravan” across Eurasia. The first train ran from Chongqing to Duisburg in 2011, taking about 16 days — far quicker than by sea. By 2024 more than 100,000 trains had run, linking over 200 European cities. They carry electronics and cars west; wine, timber and machinery east.

clips.send: 援外医疗队（阿尔及利亚，1963年）。坚持六十年的援外医疗。1963年，中国向阿尔及利亚派出第一支援外医疗队。此后先后向70多个国家和地区派出医疗队，多数在非洲，累计诊治患者约2.9亿人次（截至2023年）。新冠疫情期间，中国向许多国家提供医疗物资和疫苗。
